meta.name: adhd-coach
meta.description: Meta-cognitive support for ADHD+OCD during any work. Invoke when the user is stuck, looping, overwhelmed, paralysed, or burning energy on the wrong thing. Not clinical — practical frameworks for productive creative work.

copy.tagline: 把卡壳循环的思绪拉回正轨,让工作重新流动起来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果工作时常因分心或纠结而停滞不前
copy.tagline_en: Get unstuck and bring looping thoughts back on track
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work often stalls due to distraction or overthinking

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你工作卡壳、反复纠结或分心跑偏时，用“两分钟开始”“记录新想法”“留进度便条”等方法温和提醒；它不打断你的专注状态，只在合适时机给建议。
howto.when: 当你卡住、循环、不知所措、无法行动，或把精力耗在错误目标上时，Claude 会介入提示；它也会在工作开始和收尾时主动给方向或便条。

say.text: 我卡在这个任务半小时了，怎么办？
say.note: 它会建议先用两分钟小目标打破僵局。

say.text: 又冒出个新点子，帮我存进待办，我继续干当前活。
say.note: 它会把点子记下来，不让你切换任务。

say.text: 我刚跑过测试又想去重跑，值得吗？
say.note: 它会提醒你几分钟前通过且没变化，别重复检查。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude notices when you're stuck, looping, overwhelmed, or off-target during work. It offers practical interventions: a two-minute start, capturing new ideas, leaving breadcrumbs, and questioning re-checks—without interrupting deep focus.
howto.when_en: It activates when you're stuck, looping, overwhelmed, paralysed, or burning energy on the wrong thing. It also prompts at session start for direction and at session end for breadcrumbs, avoiding flow-state interruptions.

say_en.text: I've been stuck on this task for half an hour—what now?
say_en.note: It suggests a two-minute start to break the stall.

say_en.text: New idea popped up—capture it for later, I'll keep working.
say_en.note: It logs it without letting you switch tasks.

say_en.text: I just ran the tests but want to rerun them—worth it?
say_en.note: It reminds you they passed minutes ago and nothing changed.
